name: COOKIES 'N' CREME
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower and Palm Oil), Cookies (#19%) {Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible vegetable oil (Palm Oil), Cocoa Solids (#2%), Emulsifier (322 (i)), Milk Solids, Raising agent (500ii)}, Milk solids (#18.6%), Corn syrup solids, Edible Vegetable oil (Palm and Palm Kernel Oil), Emulsifier (322 (i) and Flavor (Artificial flavouring substance - Vanillin) ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS MILK, SOY AND WHEAT.
